title: Spire and Crown
author: Theo Dravenmoor
blurb: Emrys Whitlock, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
